title: Not-all-equal emergence is strongly-connected percolation on twisted tori, with an exact duality
subject: What decides consistency of fair not-all-equal worlds, and which identities hold on twisted tori
conclusion: A fair not-all-equal world is inconsistent exactly when the swap-reversed random orientation of its bipartite double cover has a swap-invariant strongly connected component, that is when its cyclic edges form a cross cluster or an odd winding. On twisted tori primal and dual cyclic edges are exactly complementary, so P(all contractible) = P(cross) and the emergence lies between -log2(1 - P0) and -log2 P0.
